name: SafeArena
intro: SafeArena针对基于LLM的网络代理滥用风险提出首个专注于恶意使用的评测基准。包含250个安全任务和250个有害任务，覆盖四个网站，评估代理在网络环境中的滥用可能性。
build_method: 人工策划, 人机协同生成, 三专家复核
metric: Task Completion Rate, Refusal Rate, Normalized Safety Score
modality: 网页截图, 文本, 浏览器交互
eval_feature: 对抗性, 多轮, 领域特定
build_method_en: Human Curation, Human-in-the-loop Generation, Three-expert Review
intro_en: SafeArena is the first benchmark focused on malicious use risks for LLM-based web agents. It includes 250 safety tasks and 250 harmful tasks across four websites, evaluating the potential for agent misuse in web environments.
metric_en: Task Completion Rate, Refusal Rate, Normalized Safety Score

drawio_review_note: Aligned with SafeArena arXiv:2503.04957 Sections 3.3-4.3 and Appendix D.3; official safearena.github.io project. SafeArena defines five harm categories across four WebArena-derived websites. Authors manually write 150 harmful tasks, add the required environment artifacts and reference objects, and pair each with a minimally changed safe task testing the same capability. GPT-4o-mini then proposes 100 additional harmful-safe pairs; humans verify intent labels, create site artifacts, and validate URLs, HTML, and reference content. Three expert authors review all 500 tasks and resolve ambiguous cases jointly. During evaluation, functional reference objects score task completion, GPT-4o and human judges assign ARIA levels from immediate refusal through successful completion, and the paper reports safe and harmful task completion, refusal rate, and a capability-normalized safety score.
